mentions.name: Geotastic
mentions.description: An AI analyst for ArcGIS that uses LLMs to generate code for analyzing city data. Targets US city data commonly stored in ArcGIS or Socrata.
mentions.problem: A lot of city data in the US is stored in ArcGIS or Socrata, making it harder to analyze.
